messages.content: My training job 4718209 died after almost half an hour. What happened?
I'll check the job's accounting record to see how it ended.

Job 4718209 ended with **OUT_OF_MEMORY** after 00:27:53: GPU memory peaked at 63.4 GiB, the full capacity of the A100 64 GB, so CUDA ran out of memory. Host RAM (85G) was not the problem. To fix it:

- lower the per-GPU batch size, or enable gradient checkpointing;
- or spread the model over more GPUs, e.g. `#SBATCH --gpus-per-node=4` with FSDP.

Note that it ran in `boost_qos_dbg`, which has a 30-minute limit, so move longer runs to `boost_usr_prod`.
